Table.Name: Command
Table.Command:
Declare @SN as nvarchar(15) Declare @Asesor as nvarchar(155) set @SN = '%' set @Asesor = '{?Asesor}' SELECT c.SlpName, a.CardCode as Codigo, b.CardName as 'Cliente', CASE WHEN a.DocSubType = 'DN' Then 'ND' Else 'FV' End as Tipo, a.DocNum, a.DocDate as Fecha, a.DocDueDate as Fec_Venc, GETDATE() as Fec_Corte, -datediff(day,getdate(),a.DocDueDate) as Dias, a.DocTotal as Total, a.PaidToDate as Abonos, (a.DocTotal-a.PaidToDate) as Saldo INTO #TEMP FROM OINV a INNER JOIN OCRD b ON a.CardCode=b.CardCode LEFT JOIN OSLP c ON a.SlpCode=c.SlpCode WHERE DocStatus = 'O' and b.CardName Like @SN and b.CardType like 'C' and c.SlpName like @Asesor
UNION ALL
SELECT c.SlpName, a.CardCode, b.CardName, 'NC' AS Tipo, a.DocNum, a.DocDate, a.DocDueDate, GETDATE() as Fec_Corte,-datediff(day,getdate(),a.DocDueDate) as Dias, a.DocTotal*-1 as DocTotal, a.PaidToDate*-1 as PaidToDate, (a.DocTotal-a.PaidToDate)*-1 as Saldo FROM ORIN a INNER JOIN OCRD b ON a.CardCode=b.CardCode LEFT JOIN OSLP c ON a.SlpCode=c.SlpCode WHERE DocStatus = 'O' and b.CardName Like @SN and b.CardType like 'C' and c.SlpName like @Asesor
UNION ALL
SELECT c.SlpName, a.ShortName, b.CardName, 'PR' as Tipo, a.TransID, a.DueDate, a.DueDate, GETDATE() as Fec_Corte, -datediff(day,getdate(),a.DueDate) as Dias, a.Credit*-1 as DocTotal, 0 as PaidToDate, a.BalDueCred*-1 as Saldo FROM JDT1 a INNER JOIN OCRD b ON a.ShortName=b.CardCode LEFT JOIN OSLP c ON b.SlpCode=c.SlpCode WHERE a.BalDueCred > 0 and a.TransType='24' and b.CardName Like @SN and b.CardType like 'C' and c.SlpName like @Asesor
UNION ALL
SELECT c.SlpName, a.ShortName, b.CardName, 'AS' as Tipo, a.TransID, a.DueDate, a.DueDate, GETDATE() as Fec_Corte, -datediff(day,getdate(),a.DueDate) as Dias, a.Credit*-1 as DocTotal, 0 as PaidToDate, a.BalDueCred*-1 as Saldo FROM JDT1 a INNER JOIN OCRD b ON a.ShortName=b.CardCode LEFT JOIN OSLP c ON b.SlpCode=c.SlpCode WHERE a.BalDueCred > 0 and a.TransType='30' and b.CardName Like @SN and b.CardType like 'C' and c.SlpName like @Asesor
ORDER BY a.CardCode
SELECT T1.City, T0.SlpName, T0.Codigo, T0.Cliente, T1.Phone1, T1.Phone2, T1.Cellular, T1.E_Mail, T1.CntctPrsn, T1.Address, T0.Tipo, T0.DocNum, T0.Fecha, T0.Fec_Venc, T0.Fec_Corte, T0.Dias, T0.Total, T0.Abonos, T0.Saldo , CASE WHEN Dias <= 0 THEN Saldo ELSE 0 END AS 'Corriente', CASE WHEN Dias BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN Saldo ELSE 0 END AS '0 - 30', CASE WHEN Dias BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN Saldo ELSE 0 END AS '31 - 60', CASE WHEN Dias BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN Saldo ELSE 0 END AS '61 - 90', CASE WHEN Dias >= 91 THEN Saldo ELSE 0 END AS 'Mas de 90', Saldo AS VR_TOTAL FROM #TEMP T0 LEFT JOIN OCRD T1 ON T0.Codigo = T1.CardCode ORDER BY T1.City, T0.SlpName, T0.Cliente, T0.Fec_Venc
drop table #TEMP
